numerical_characteristics.precision: Division computed in float64 (53-bit mantissa) rounds integers above 2**53; exact computation in Python ints is the fix, with truncation toward zero
numerical_characteristics.magnitude: Quotients above 2**53; int64 extremes Timedelta.min/max (values near 2**63-1 in nanoseconds), e.g. 36028797018963967 (2**55-1 range)
category_specific_evidence: Commit: Timedelta.__truediv__ built quotient as <int64_t>(self._value / other), applying integer divisor in float64; quotients above 2**53 came back rounded
